integrity: Analytic proof supported by exact rational witness and independent finite Markov-specialization checks; no claim of full priority coverage.
scientific_limitations: Both stiffnesses must be positive and sojourn means finite; untrapped and infinite-mean regimes are outside proof.
Equalities are only of occupations, conditional second moments, potential energy and mean work, not full stationary distributions.
Frydel provides an age-structured framework that could produce two-time quantities after further derivation; source comparison cannot prove all possible unstated implications.
Bibliography is bounded to searched source corpus; implicit general semi-Markov linear response work may predate the explicit reduction.
One relevant Biroli et al. comparison used abstract/model scope rather than complete full text; its subject differs materially.
No independent audit, experimental check or full nonzero-frequency spectrum.
title: A spectral discriminator for semi-Markov switching harmonic traps
